time_budget.forecast: Uses actual medium fit seconds/update and worst measured eval seconds/scene; includes24 long evaluations and4 full50k evaluations,15percent fit/long margin, full-audit=max20min or measured full cost times1.25. If minimum does not fit, explicitly attempts minimum with deadline_risk; no completion guarantee.

collision_rate.raw_unit: fraction of generated vehicles involved in at least one overlap

metric_units.definition: distance.jensenshannon(p,q)**2; distance returns sqrtJSD; evaluator explicitly squares it, default logarithm base is natural. Histogram counts are pooled across vehicles then divergence computed.
metric_units.native_example: speed_jsd=2 means rawJSD0.02; lat_dev_jsd=0.2 also means rawJSD0.02. Neither is square-root distance.

selection_formula.primary: M_arm,k=(1/2)sum_TRAIN [(1/2)sum_GEN metric_arm,TRAIN,GEN,k]; r_k=M_candidate,k/M_control,k; R=(1/7)sum_k r_k; R_attr=(r_length+r_width+r_speed)/3
selection_formula.units: dimensionless; each component scale10/100 cancels within its own ratio
selection_formula.interpretation: R=.95 means5percent lower mean normalized metric ratios, not5percent gain on every component or5percent accuracy. Means of paired TRAIN ratios are auxiliary and need not equal primary. GEN2 repeats do not make N_TRAIN4.
selection_formula.sqrt_warning: Changing JSD to sqrtJSD changes ratios to approximatelysqrt(r) at a single observation and can change average-ratio ranks; no square-root transformation is authorized in selection. Native raw or scaledJSD preserves same per-component ratios.
selection_formula.gates: Pooled arm means AND each TRAIN mean: onroad_fraction>=control-.02, generated_vehicle/GT_vehicle in[.9,1.1], each L/W/speed ratio<=1.15. R<1 alone does not suffice.

TRAIN_roles.5817: one independently held TRAIN confirmation seed

evaluation_scope.canonicalization_evidence: Native numeric index prefix and .pt wrapper map to original .pkl filename; prior actual metadata audit verified filenames/timesteps. Do not parse terminal suffix as map_id/timestep.
evaluation_scope.same_metric_definition_not_same_target_d: 4096 matched uses only those selected GT entries;50000 matched pools all official GT entries. On complete membership matched GT histograms/counts equal full_real exactly. Cannot mix rankings across scopes.
evaluation_scope.auxiliary_full_reference_field: full_reference_agent_metrics compares subset generated data against full50kGT when evaluation is partial. It is diagnostic and not the primary matched agent_metrics used for selection.
evaluation_scope.population: Generated type0 vehicles; fixed ego included if vehicle. GT map geometry is used for lane-conditioned metrics; current initialization does not generate lanes. Nearest/L/W/speed/collision use all vehicles, lat/angle only onroad vehicles at lane distance<=1.5m. Generated agents are not culled by GT validity/FOV/offroad filters; optional model existence can apply.
evaluation_scope.collision: Count colliding vehicles, not collision pairs; vehicle-weighted global percentage, not mean scene collision rates. Five-circle overlap helper.
evaluation_scope.histograms: Fixed bins, clipped physical tails; speed1m/s bins cannot identify an exact stationary mass. Ego fixed values contribute to histograms; JSD includes population/type changes.
evaluation_scope.full50k_audit_reused_TRAIN: 4817 only,2GEN per arm, not second independent TRAIN test
evaluation_scope.full50k_not_strict_unseen: It includes all4096 selection entries; corpus previously inspected.50k entries are43601 unique original raw keys.4096 is also reused by medium/long selection. Report broader-scope audit, not unseen confirmation.

source_chain_note: source_freeze stores model/data/runner hashes. Metric helper source appears in per-GEN official_source_sha256; metric_core SHA is recorded in GT database backend_signature and verified against current source. Current CPU review records remaining evaluator/real-cache file hashes; do not claim their bytes were originally in source_freeze when absent.
limitations: No actual final matrix yet; no winner verified or materialized by this review
18-arm selection is adaptive; best short-budget result may regress at longer budgets or128epochs
Equal exposure still allows B/update/EMA dynamics to differ, and novel arms inherit joint-loss+sincos anchor; do not attribute candidate-vs-control change to one added speed feature
Interrupted stages, prior SIGSEGV attempts, CPU preflight and384-step GPU runtime pilot are excluded from model-selection evidence
